topic: Ramzan: helping prepare iftar with fruit chaat and pakoras.

episode.title: Mano aur Sheru: Iftar Ki Taiyari!

shots.narration: کیا مانو اور شیرو افطار وقت پر تیار کر پائیں گے؟
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, colourful Pakistani courtyard beneath a neem tree, soft late-afternoon sunlight, rounded 3D family-film style. A low table holds empty bowls, chopped fruit and a platter of prepared pakoras. No text or markings.
shots.action: Mano lifts an empty serving bowl beside Sheru.
shots.mood: Bright blue kitten eyes, eager smiles, inviting warm colours.

shots.narration: مانو نے کہا، میں سارا پھل پیالے میں ڈالوں گی!
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, text-free 3D courtyard table with a small serving bowl and a wide tray of chopped bananas, apples and oranges.
shots.action: Mano tips the fruit tray into the small bowl.
shots.mood: Confident kitten grin, playfully ambitious pose.

shots.narration: [surprised] ارے، پیالہ تو چھوٹا پڑ گیا!
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, text-free 3D close view of the clean courtyard tabletop, an overflowing fruit bowl and scattered fruit pieces.
shots.action: Mano catches a fruit piece rolling across the tabletop.
shots.mood: Wide blue eyes, harmless colourful mess, gently comic surprise.

shots.narration: شیرو بولا، کوئی بات نہیں، دوسرا پیالہ لے آتے ہیں۔
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, text-free 3D courtyard table beneath leafy neem shadows, overflowing fruit bowl in front of Mano.
shots.action: Sheru places a second empty bowl beside the first.
shots.mood: Sheru's reassuring smile, Mano's relieved expression.

shots.narration: مانو نے کچھ پھل دوسرے پیالے میں ڈال دیا۔
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, text-free 3D close view of two fruit bowls on a clean courtyard table, a large rounded serving spoon.
shots.action: Mano spoons excess fruit into the second bowl.
shots.mood: Careful paws, focused blue eyes, balanced colourful bowls.

shots.narration: [chuckles] اب شیرو نے فروٹ چاٹ اچھی طرح ملا دی۔
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, text-free 3D courtyard tabletop with two comfortably filled fruit bowls and a rounded wooden spoon.
shots.action: Sheru stirs one bowl of fruit chaat.
shots.mood: Happy concentration, relaxed pointy ears, warm sunlight.

shots.narration: مانو نے پہلے سے تیار پکوڑے بھی سجا دیے۔
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, text-free 3D courtyard serving table with cooled, prepared golden pakoras on a plain platter; no stove or cooking equipment.
shots.action: Mano arranges the pakoras neatly on the platter.
shots.mood: Proud little smile, tidy golden food arrangement.

shots.narration: کھجوریں بھی افطار کی میز پر آ گئیں۔
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, text-free 3D courtyard table with two fruit chaat bowls and a pakora platter, sunset light on colourful walls.
shots.action: Mano sets a small dish of dates beside the fruit chaat.
shots.mood: Neat welcoming table, cheerful kitten expression.

shots.narration: [excited] شیرو پانی لایا، اب میز بھرنے لگی!
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, text-free 3D courtyard iftar table with fruit chaat, dates and pakoras, a clear space beside the dishes.
shots.action: Sheru sets down a tray holding water glasses.
shots.mood: Steady helpful paws, proud smile, sparkling clear water.

shots.narration: مانو نے میز بھی صاف کر دی۔
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, text-free 3D courtyard table with completed iftar dishes and a few fruit juice spots along the near edge.
shots.action: Mano wipes the tabletop with a clean cloth.
shots.mood: Attentive kitten face, freshly polished table, soft orange light.

shots.narration: دونوں کی مدد سے افطار کی میز تیار ہو گئی!
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, text-free 3D wide courtyard view beneath the neem tree, neatly arranged fruit chaat, pakoras, dates and water on the low table.
shots.action: Mano and Sheru spread their paws toward the finished table.
shots.mood: Matching proud smiles, peaceful Ramadan evening, warm glowing courtyard.

shots.narration: [excited] مل کر کام کریں، اگلی بار سحری کی تیاری ہوگی!
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, text-free 3D courtyard beside the finished iftar table, neem leaves overhead and a softly glowing evening sky.
shots.action: Mano and Sheru exchange a gentle high-five.
shots.mood: Joyful best-friend smiles, bright eyes, cosy celebratory colours.

episode.endHook: اگلی بار مانو اور شیرو سحری کی تیاری کریں گے!
episode.description: رمضان میں مانو اور شیرو مل کر افطار کی تیاری کرتے ہیں۔ فروٹ چاٹ اور پکوڑے سجاتے ہوئے دونوں سیکھتے ہیں کہ مل کر کام کرنا کتنا اچھا ہے!
